summary: End-to-end workflow automation across n8n, GoHighLevel, Retell AI, HubSpot, Filevine, Zapier, Make.com, and Google Sheets — connecting your tools into intelligent, self-running systems.
title: AI Automation & Workflow Integration
seoTitle: AI Automation — n8n, GoHighLevel, Retell AI, HubSpot & Make.com
seoDescription: AI-powered workflow automation: n8n, GoHighLevel, Retell AI voice agents, HubSpot, Filevine, Zapier, Make.com, and Google Sheets integrated into self-running business systems.
contentHtml:
I build AI-powered automation systems that connect your business tools and let them run themselves — from lead capture and voice agents to CRM updates, document workflows, and reporting. Instead of manual copy-paste between apps, your stack becomes one intelligent, self-running pipeline.

Workflow Automation with n8n & Make.com

Self-hosted n8n, Make.com, and Zapier workflows that orchestrate multi-step processes across dozens of apps, with error handling, retries, and AI decision steps built in.

CRM & Sales Automation

Deep integrations with GoHighLevel and HubSpot — automated lead routing, pipeline updates, follow-up sequences, and enrichment triggered by real events across your systems.

AI Voice & Chat Agents

Retell AI voice agents and chat assistants for outbound and inbound calls, appointment booking, and qualification — with live transcription, sentiment analysis, and automatic CRM logging.

Legal & Document Workflows

Filevine and document-driven automation for intake, case management, and data sync — connecting legal-tech platforms to the rest of your stack.

Data & Reporting

Google Sheets, databases, and dashboards kept in sync automatically, so reporting and analytics stay current without manual effort.

Let's Talk Automation

label: Agentic AI Development
summary: Autonomous, tool-using AI agents and multi-agent systems that plan, act, and complete real business workflows end to end.
title: Agentic AI Development
seoTitle: Agentic AI Development — Autonomous AI Agents & Multi-Agent Systems
seoDescription: I build production agentic AI: tool-using autonomous agents, multi-agent orchestration, memory, and human-in-the-loop workflows with LangGraph, MCP, and OpenAI/Claude.
contentHtml:
I design and ship agentic AI systems — LLM-powered agents that reason, call tools, use memory, and take real actions instead of just answering questions. From single task-runners to orchestrated multi-agent teams, I build agents that reliably complete end-to-end business workflows with the right guardrails.

Autonomous Agents

Goal-driven agents that plan multi-step tasks, choose and call tools (APIs, databases, search, code execution), observe results, and self-correct until the objective is met.

Multi-Agent Orchestration

Coordinated agent teams — planner, researcher, executor, reviewer — built with LangGraph and MCP so complex work is decomposed, parallelised, and recombined predictably.

Tools, Memory & MCP

Model Context Protocol servers, function/tool calling, vector and episodic memory, and retrieval so agents stay grounded, remember context across turns, and act on your live systems.

Human-in-the-Loop & Guardrails

Approval gates, cost/rate controls, evals, and observability so autonomous behaviour stays safe, auditable, and production-ready.

Let's Talk Agentic AI

label: LLMOps
summary: Production operations for LLM apps: evaluation, prompt versioning, observability, guardrails, cost control, and continuous improvement.
title: LLMOps — Operating LLM Applications in Production
seoTitle: LLMOps — Evaluation, Observability & Guardrails for LLM Apps
seoDescription: LLMOps done right: eval pipelines, prompt/version management, tracing and observability, guardrails, caching and cost control for reliable production LLM systems.
contentHtml:
Shipping an LLM demo is easy; running one reliably in production is not. I put the operational layer around your LLM and RAG applications so they stay accurate, fast, safe, and affordable as they scale.

Evaluation & Testing

Automated eval suites (golden sets, LLM-as-judge, regression tests) wired into CI so every prompt or model change is measured before it ships.

Observability & Tracing

End-to-end tracing of prompts, retrievals, tool calls, tokens, latency, and cost — so you can see exactly why the model answered the way it did and fix it fast.

Prompt & Version Management

Versioned prompts, A/B rollouts, and safe rollbacks, decoupled from application deploys.

Guardrails & Cost Control

Input/output validation, PII and jailbreak protection, semantic caching, model routing, and token budgeting to cut spend without hurting quality.

Let's Talk LLMOps

I build AI-native software products where intelligence is part of the architecture — semantic search, copilots, RAG, recommendations, and automation designed in from day one and shipped as polished, production full-stack apps.

AI-Native Architecture

Systems designed around embeddings, vector stores, LLM orchestration, and event-driven pipelines — not a chatbot stapled onto a legacy app.

Full-Stack Delivery

Modern web apps with Next.js, FastAPI, Node.js, PostgreSQL, and vector databases, from data model to responsive UI to deployment.

Intelligent Features

Copilots, semantic search, document Q&A, smart recommendations, and workflow automation embedded directly into your product experience.

Production Engineering

Testing, CI/CD, monitoring, and cloud infrastructure so the AI product is reliable, observable, and ready to scale.

Let's Build Your AI Product

label: Forward-Deployed Engineer (FDE)

title: Forward-Deployed Engineer (FDE)
seoDescription: Forward-deployed AI engineering: embedded with your team to scope, prototype, integrate, and deploy LLM/ML systems against real production data and workflows.
contentHtml:
As a Forward-Deployed Engineer, I embed with your team to take AI from idea to deployed reality — working against your real data, systems, and users, closing the gap between a promising model and a system that actually runs the business.

Embedded Delivery

I sit with your stakeholders, learn the domain, and build in your environment — fast iterations against real requirements instead of a spec thrown over the wall.

Rapid Prototyping to Production

From a working prototype in days to a hardened, integrated deployment — RAG systems, agents, pipelines, and internal tools that fit your stack.

Integration with Real Systems

Connecting LLMs and ML to your CRMs, databases, warehouses, and APIs, handling the messy edge cases production always brings.

Enablement & Handoff

Documentation, observability, and knowledge transfer so your team owns and extends the system after I roll off.

Let's Work Together
